analysis: Dev success is saturated at about 0.990-0.998 across many recipes, and the differences are within seed noise. The big gain came from the update-heavy recipe: lr 0.0015, 4 epochs, 8 minibatches, 128 envs, depth 3. Width 128 times out. iou_delta with bonus 5 scored 1.0 once and 0.996 on a repeat, so it is no clearly better than cells. Layernorm, gelu, gae 0.95 and gamma changes make no clear difference. The remaining proposals are small, safe variants near the best config, all under about 335s.

proposals.hypothesis: Noise check and the likely final recipe: t22 config (iou_delta, bonus 5) with a different seed. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
iou_delta with bonus 5 plus GELU, since GELU gave 0.996 twice with cells. It may reduce the rare failures. Refuted if dev success is below 0.997.
iou_delta, bonus 5, lr 0.002 and rollout_len 32 with 64 envs. Longer rollouts gave a good result before, and the higher lr may converge more fully. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
Cells reward with bonus 5, gae 0.95 and ent_coef 0.003 (no layernorm). This combines the best train-success settings with a slightly lower entropy. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
